## Changes
- The Dashboard's period list and the Settings category list now sit on the right. The Dashboard's Overview and By app panels moved to the left. - A new call's day heading no longer opens above the visible part of the Dashboard after you have scrolled or jumped to a period. - After you click a period, any scroll you make yourself hands the highlight back to the period you are looking at. - With a non-Gregorian calendar (for example Japanese), older years in the period list show their proper year names. - The Dashboard does less work while you search and when it redraws dates.

## Changes
- The Dashboard now groups calls by period: Today, Yesterday, This week, Last week, Earlier this month, Last month, then one heading per month. - A list of those periods sits left of the feed, in the same style as the Settings categories. It shows where you are as you scroll, and clicking a period jumps to it. Earlier years appear as one entry each. The list hides in narrow windows and while you search. - Calls with a topic or a name you gave them now show their day on the Dashboard card, for example "Sat, 17 Oct · 18:02".

## Changes
- Ahoy now tells you when a call's transcript is ready, or when it couldn't transcribe a call and why. Click the notification to open the call. - While a call is being transcribed, the menu bar shows its progress. Afterwards it points out calls that couldn't be transcribed or are waiting for you to pick a language; click the line to open the call. - Deleting a call now moves it to the Trash instead of removing it for good. A banner offers Undo (or ⌘Z) until you dismiss it, delete something else or close the window, and Undo brings back the call with its transcript, insights and reminders. - A call that is still being transcribed can be moved to the Trash once it finishes. - New installs no longer record calls automatically; setup asks. Your current setting is kept.
